title: LIQUIDITY_POOL_DEPOSIT fails with LIQUIDITY_POOL_DEPOSIT_LINE_FULL
pattern: A transaction whose LIQUIDITY_POOL_DEPOSIT operation fails at apply is still written into the closed ledger: its fee is charged, its sequence number is consumed, and nothing it did is kept. The result carries the operation's code (line_full). The pool-share trustline's limit is one stroop.

hazards.placement: deposit into a pool-share trustline limited to one stroop

facts.says: No operation changed state: the operation meta is empty.
The fee is still charged: the fee source changes in fee processing.
